crossRefs.note: David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, “How could Yahweh’s ark come to me?”
So David would not move Yahweh’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the…
The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
“Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I…
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry…
For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…

translations.web: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
translations.bsb: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, you have what belongs to you.’
translations.kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
translations.asv: and I was afraid, and went away and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, thou hast thine own.
